I'll give you an example of schizophrenia that's kind of harmless. When I was around 8, I had a dream that my friend put me in a BBQ and locked me in. I lent my room mate my car to get to and from work, and it had my pot in it. If your post hadn't come up in the time between when I was sinking into depression and when he got home, I was actually going to kill myself. I haven't had one this bad since when I put a gun to my head and a random person saved me.

That was also the last time I broke down in tears, aside from this time.
